traditions.KJV: wherein your fathers have dwelt ;

25.english_reference: and they shall dwell therein, [ even ] they, and their children, and their children ’s children for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶ֡י הָ הֵ֠מָּה וּ בְנֵי הֶ֞ם וּ בְנֵ֤י בְנֵי הֶם֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπ᾽ αὐτῆς αὐτοί .
traditions.VUL: et habitábunt super eam ipsi , et fílii eórum , et fílii filiórum eórum , usque in sempitérnum :
traditions.KJV: and they shall dwell therein , [ even ] they , and their children , and their children ’s children for ever :

25.english_reference: and my servant David [ shall be ] their prince for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ דָוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔ י נָשִׂ֥יא לָ הֶ֖ם לְ עוֹלָֽם

traditions.VUL: et David servus meus princeps eórum in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: and my servant David [ shall be ] their prince for ever .

26.english_reference: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them

traditions.WLC: וְ כָרַתִּ֤י לָ הֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם

traditions.KJV: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them ;

26.english_reference: it shall be an everlasting covenant with them

traditions.WLC: בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ ם

traditions.VUL: pactum sempitérnum erit eis :
traditions.KJV: it shall be an everlasting covenant with them :

26.english_reference: and I will place them, and multiply them

traditions.KJV: and I will place them , and multiply them ,

26.english_reference: and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore

traditions.KJV: and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore .

27.english_reference: My tabernacle also shall be with them :

27.english_reference: yea , I will be their God ,
